name: Brother Marcus

abilities.name: Zealous Strike
abilities.description: An attack fueled by fanatical devotion that hits with unexpected force

abilities.name: Dark Blessing
abilities.description: Channels unholy energy to ignore pain and fight through injuries

appearance.skin_tone: pale from too much time underground
appearance.hair: shaved head, branded with cult symbol on scalp
appearance.distinctive_features: Heavy black plate armor with skull motifs, cult symbols carved into armor, ritual scars on forearms

personality.demeanor: Stands perfectly still when not moving, shows no emotion, stares unblinkingly at threats
personality.speaking_style: Recites cult doctrine, speaks in ritualistic phrases, never questions orders aloud

beliefs: The Witch King's will is absolute and divine
Death in service is the highest honor
Suffering purifies the soul and strengthens faith
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Fights with disciplined precision and absolute fearlessness. Will follow orders exactly even if it means certain death. Defends assigned position without deviation. Never retreats, never surrenders. Feels no pity or hesitation. Views dying in battle as achieving paradise.

visible: Heavy black plate armor with skull motifs
Large shield bearing the Witch King's symbol
Unholy symbol on chain around neck
hidden: Small prayer book with cult liturgy

secrets: Joined the cult after his family was killed by bandits - seeks meaning through service
Has doubts about the cult but is too afraid to leave or voice them
The cult brand on his head magically amplifies his loyalty and suppresses independent thought
backstory: A farmer's son who lost everything to bandits. The Witch King's cult found him broken and desperate, offering purpose and power. He underwent brutal indoctrination and was branded with magical symbols that enforce obedience. Now serves as an elite guard, his personality subsumed by fanatical devotion.
